blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks snapped a three-session losing streak on Tuesday as investors bought battered shares, supported by a recovery in regional markets despite the peso’s slide past P64 against the dollar. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) climbed 120.01 points, or 2.13 percent, to close at 5,761.19.
